summary: Stamagri is a family business in 't Zand, Noord-Holland, run by Milo and Zico Stam. It trades and exports NAK-certified seed potatoes, buys, grades and packs table potatoes, and sells fresh-cut fries made from Agria grown on its own land. The family's potato growing in 't Zand dates back to 1966.
founded: 1966 (roots: grandfather first planted potatoes in 't Zand)
ownership: Family-owned, run by Milo and Zico Stam (third generation)
products: NAK-certified seed potatoes (classes S / SE / E / A)
Processing potatoes for fries and crisps (on request)
Representation of varieties Obama and Festo
facts: 5,000 m² production hall with automated sorting and packing lines and cold storage
Sorting speed of 30 tonnes per hour
Trades 20+ varieties; availability varies by season
Obama and Festo represented in cooperation with Selectiebedrijf Kooi BV
Packs in 10, 25 or 50 kg bags and 1,000-1,250 kg big bags
limitations: Hectares, seed volumes, seed generations and export volumes by country are not published on the pages read.
No own breeding programme, overseas agents or foreign branches are published; capacity figures are the company's own statements.
